commits.message:
Update teaching.md

Update teaching information

Change project title

Change title for market income project

Increase .profile width to 150px

Update assets/css/main.scss to change the .profile width from 100px to 150px, enlarging the profile area for improved layout/visual balance.

Reduce .profile width to 100px

Update assets/css/main.scss: change .profile width from 150px to 100px to tighten the layout and improve spacing.

Add .profile width override

Add a custom overrides block to assets/css/main.scss and set .profile width to 150px to standardize profile element sizing across the site.

Update about page address and code block styling

Added a hyperlink to the Kamerlingh Onnes Building address on the about page for easier access to location details. Changed code block paragraph display from inline-block to block in SCSS for improved formatting.

Update YAML multiline string style in about page

Changed the 'more_info' field in the about page profile from the '|' (literal) to '>' (folded) YAML multiline string style for improved formatting.

Update YAML multiline string indicator in about.md

Changed the 'more_info' field from '>' to '|' to preserve line breaks in the address formatting.

Remove external link from about page address

Replaced the linked Kamerlingh Onnes Building address with plain text in the about page for a simpler presentation.

Update address formatting on about page

Reformatted the address in the about page profile section to use separate paragraphs for each line, improving readability.

Update address formatting on about page

Replaced paragraph tags with line breaks in the address section for improved formatting and readability.

Fix indentation for profile more_info in about page

Corrected the indentation of the 'more_info' field in the profile section of about.md to ensure proper formatting and parsing.

Format address block in about page profile

Condensed the address information in the profile section of about.md into a single line for improved formatting and readability.

Update address formatting in about page

Changed the address in the about page to use separate paragraph tags for each line and updated the Kamerlingh Onnes Building link URL for consistency.

Emphasize project title in work in progress list

Updated the formatting of 'De verdeling van marktinkomens, 1977-2024' to bold in the work in progress section for consistency with other listed projects.

Add country to address in about page

Appended 'The Netherlands' to the address in the about page for improved clarity and completeness.

Update contact info formatting on About page

Consolidated address details into a single HTML paragraph with line breaks for improved readability on the About page.

Update about page with new work in progress

Added a new work in progress project on market income distribution (1977-2024) with collaborators. Also updated the description of doctoral studies for clarity.

Fix casing and formatting in header and about page

Corrected 'CTRL K' to 'Ctrl K' in the header search button for consistency. Changed the markdown multiline string indicator in about.md from '>' to '|' for proper formatting.

Update theme colors and header search label

Changed hover and theme colors in _themes.scss for improved visual consistency. Updated the search shortcut label in header.liquid from 'ctrl k' to 'CTRL K' for clarity.

Remove profiles page

Deleted the _pages/profiles.md file, which contained configuration and content for the lab or group members page. This change removes the profiles listing from the site.

Update page titles and theme colors, remove about_einstein.md

Capitalized titles on about, CV, and teaching pages for consistency. Updated CV page description. Changed theme color variables in _themes.scss from purple/cyan to green variants. Removed the unused about_einstein.md page.

Update _config.yml footer and icon settings

Removed Unsplash photo credit from the footer and cleared the favicon emoji in the configuration.

Remove placeholder description from teaching page

Cleared the default description text from the teaching page to allow for a custom or empty description.

Add 'Work in Progress' section to about page

Added a new section listing ongoing research projects to provide more information about current work and collaborations.

Update .prettierignore and socials.yml configuration

Added markdown, YAML, and JSON files to .prettierignore to exclude them from formatting. Updated _data/socials.yml with new CV PDF path, enabled GitHub and LinkedIn usernames, added ORCID ID, and commented out Inspire HEP, RSS icon, and Scholar user ID for configuration clarity.

Replace placeholder CV with Sander Kraaij's information

Removed placeholder data for Albert Einstein from cv.yml and resume.json, replacing them with empty structures. Updated about.md to introduce Sander Kraaij, and cv.md to reference the new CV PDF (CV_Sander_Kraaij.pdf) and update the description. Added the actual CV PDF to assets/pdf. Minor formatting adjustment in teaching.md.

Fix indentation in about page profile info

Corrected the indentation of the 'more_info' HTML block in the profile section of about.md for improved readability and consistency.

Update about page layout and content settings

Refined the profile address formatting and corrected the Kamerlingh Onnes Building link. Disabled selected papers, announcements, and latest posts sections for a cleaner about page.

Update contact info in about page

Replaced office location text with a hyperlink to Kamerlingh Onnes Building and specified room number for clarity.

Remove custom_social entry and update teaching page

Deleted the unused custom_social section from socials.yml and replaced en dashes with double hyphens in the teaching.md course list for consistency.

Update personal info, bio, and navigation settings

Updated personal details and contact information in _config.yml and _data/socials.yml. Revised the about page with a new biography, photo, and address. Disabled navigation for several pages and updated the teaching page with current courses. Removed placeholder content and customized the site for Alexander C. Kraaij.
